name: Xbox button icons
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: The game's PlayStation 2 button icons as an Xbox controller's, painted in the game's own style: A, B, X and Y on the game's dark buttons in green, red, blue and yellow, and LB, RB, LT and RT for L1, R1, L2 and R2. Everywhere the game prints a button: help, menus, the vendor.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log each time the fonts are painted, or found not to be the game's.
